mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine tracing the path of money—not just the coins in your pocket, but the very idea of what we call 'value.' From trading shells and gold in bustling markets, to trusting government-issued bills in our wallets, the story of money is really the story of civilization itself. We’ve seen empires rise and fall, all because of how people chose to store and exchange their wealth. Now, what if I told you there’s a way to look at money that turns everything you thought you knew on its head? In Saifedean Ammous’s thought-provoking book, The Bitcoin Standard: The Decentralized Alternative to Central Banking, we get to explore this very idea—how our understanding of money shapes society, and what might happen when we break free from the old systems. Together, we’ll journey through history, discovering how centralized control over currency has left us vulnerable—from inflation, to manipulation, to entire economies at risk. But here’s where things get really interesting: with the rise of Bitcoin, we’re not just talking about another tech fad. We’re witnessing a bold new vision—a digital asset built on decentralization, challenging the power structures that have dominated our financial lives for generations. As we dive in, we’ll uncover not just the mechanics of Bitcoin, but the big ideas behind it: economic freedom, personal sovereignty, and a more resilient financial system. So, if you’re ready to rethink what money could be, and how it might empower all of us in ways we’ve never imagined, let’s explore this journey together.
